hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Set by Check For Updates when the exact release input contains banner rollout metadata.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_MANUAL_OPERATOR_MODE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Enable only for an operator-started forward banner run with one Jenkins UserIdCause.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Deployment expected in the exact release input. Required for forward banner runs.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_EXPECTED_TUPLE_SHA256
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Tuple expected in the exact release input. Required for forward banner runs.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: STACK_S3_BUCKET
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Exact artifact bucket propagated to every banner build and deploy leaf.
